<!--
This page is generated. Do not edit the list by hand.

  python3 scripts/update_pubs.py

Two fields control where an entry lands, and the script sets both:

  featured: true   an entry with an `image:` set, shown in the grid
  era: current     2015 onward; era: prior is anything earlier

Change ERA_CUTOFF at the top of the script to move the boundary. Image
assignments are preserved across runs, so adding a cover figure is a one-time
job per paper and promotes it into the grid.
-->
